Summary

A growth-product operator who engineers agentic systems and ships them into production. I collapse the latency between strategy and execution. I built ARCS, a production AI-native platform on Claude with a custom MCP server, agentic pipelines, retrieval and context management, and an evaluation layer that decides when deterministic context is enough versus when LLM reasoning is required. On the growth side I have driven net-new revenue through personalization and lifecycle systems across CDP and MarTech stacks, and I structure content and information architecture so systems can actually use it. Twenty years of product, growth, and cross-functional delivery, aligning product, legal, and brand, with the design foundation to make agentic experiences coherent, not just functional.
